parts.text: A beaker contains some water at room temperature. A student places a mercury-in-glass thermometer in the water with the bulb of the thermometer just beneath the surface of the water. Fig. 4.1 shows the arrangement. Fig. 4.1 The student uses an electric fan to blow air across the open top of the beaker. She notices that the reading on the thermometer begins to decrease.
